# WAPlus WhatsApp CRM Chrome Extension

Official Chrome Extension for InHostBilling & Click2IT Hosting Portal.
Enables multi-agent customer query handling, lead management, and quick hosting canned responses directly inside WhatsApp Web (`web.whatsapp.com`).

## How to Install (Takes 30 seconds):
1. Download or extract the extension files into a folder on your computer.
2. In Google Chrome, Brave, or Microsoft Edge, navigate to:
   `chrome://extensions/`
3. Toggle on **"Developer mode"** in the top right corner.
4. Click the **"Load unpacked"** button in the top left.
5. Select this `waplus-extension` directory.
6. Open [WhatsApp Web](https://web.whatsapp.com) — the WAPlus Hosting CRM floating dock will automatically appear in the bottom-right corner!

## Features Included:
- **WhatsApp Web Overlay Dock**: Direct CRM sidebar inside web.whatsapp.com
- **1-Click Canned Responses**: Welcome message, Nameservers, cPanel login URL, Invoice payment links, VPS activation credentials
- **Multi-Agent Sync**: Synced directly with InHostBilling portal CRM API
- **Lead Pipeline**: Tag leads, record internal agent notes, and track customer lifecycle
